We evaluate FLARE on 4 diverse tasks/datasets involving generating long outputs, including multihop QA (2WikiMultihopQA), commonsense reasoning (StrategyQA), long-form QA (ASQA), and open-domain summarization (WikiAsp).

Increasingly powerful large LMs have also demonstrated abilities in more complex tasks that involve generating long-form output, such as longform QA , open-domain summarization , and (chain-of-thought; CoT) reasoning .

We use regular expressions to extract the final answer from the output and compare it with the reference answer using exact match (EM), and token-level F1, precision, and recall. Metrics include ROUGE, named entity-based F1, and UniEval.
